cause_quote: The new `const result = published() ? undefined : (work()?.branch ?? changes());` hid local counts after publication, and the new `retainedPublication(publication) && (publication?.result?.status !== "published" || publication.error)` fallback let a stale failure show Retry beside a live PR.
user_saw: Local change counts disappeared from Environment after publishing a pull request, and an earlier failed attempt could leave a Retry button beside an existing pull request.
summary: The fix keeps local change counts linked to Uncommitted review after publication and suppresses duplicate Retry when the Gateway reports a live PR for the checkout.
reasoning: I checked the parent of #179029, where Environment rendered the Uncommitted action under `<Show when={changes()}>` independently of the existing PR publication flow. The #179029 diff moved publication controls into Environment, gated both count-rendering paths on publication status, and let retained failures mount branch actions even when a live PR was already listed.
